title: Route repository validation through an overlay view
description:
Existing repository validation reads through one injectable, read-only view so the unchanged filesystem path and a planned-byte overlay execute the identical validation pipeline.

## Background

Profile planning must validate the exact proposed final repository without letting any validator reopen live files and judge a different state. This leaf introduces that reusable validation boundary without adding profile commands or types.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Filesystem and overlay views drive effective config, rules/schema, gates/templates, item links, projections, issue/event/index records, DAG, namespace/hierarchy, and repository-integrity passes without reopening the storage root.
- [hard] REQ-02: Overlay tests deliberately make live and planned bytes disagree and prove every named pass judges the planned final state, while filesystem-view regression tests preserve current validation results.

## Scope

**Blast radius:** repository-view trait and the config/gate/template/item/projection/validation readers only, with parity and adversarial overlay tests; no profile type or command is introduced.

**Green landing:** All existing validation callers use the filesystem view unchanged, and an internal overlay can validate arbitrary final bytes independently of profiles.
